decision: D-814: medium-inert sketch look admitted with disclosure

selection.rule: flowchart original whose config carries look: handDrawn (plus an optional positive handDrawnSeed) and whose body is otherwise admissible; the disclosure footer is unclaimed ink for the Flow400 geometry oracle

review.reviewer_agent: independent adversarial review (Claude Code subagent, D-814 medium-inert look cohort, 2026-11-26; r1 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r2 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r3 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r4 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r5 APPROVE)
review.note: Five adversarial rounds against the working tree: r1 REQUEST-CHANGES (matrix branch not wired into the flow accumulator, twelve-row overlap with the FS-3a/FS-4h/FS-6/FS-7b ledgers, ledger-approval vs generator-check conflict, missing twin assertion), r2 REQUEST-CHANGES (re-baselined ledger metadata described the old look gate), r3 REQUEST-CHANGES (spacing cohort framed look as a hard gate, FS-6 policy arithmetic, stale comments), r4 REQUEST-CHANGES (spacing addendum dropped by review preservation, two comment/docstring residuals), r5 APPROVE. The durable gate renders every row at 240/40/240 and compares every art row above the footer with the config-free body twin.

rows.cause: config.look=handDrawn is the rough.js sketch skin; a terminal draws table glyphs, so the leaf is medium-inert: every art row above the disclosure footer equals the config-free body twin, and the footer names the unapplied skin. The disclosure footer is unclaimed ink for the Flow400 geometry oracle, so the row admits on reviewed source-byte identity instead of a Model
notices: config.look=handDrawn -> source node style; not applied
